question: What further details about the meditation does Pārvatī ask Śaṃkara to reveal?
premises: Pārvatī asks who is to be meditated upon
She addresses Śaṃkara as kind to devotees
inference: Pārvatī asks who is to be meditated upon here and requests all those details from the devotee-kind lord.
plain_english: Who is to be meditated upon here? Tell me all of that, O you who are kind to devotees.
